description: This file defines a Java interface named ContentImageRemove, which extends another interface ImageRemove. It declares a method removeImage for removing images based on merchant store code, content type, and image name, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: ContentImageRemove
classes.description: A Java interface for removing images related to content, extending functionality from ImageRemove.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes an image given its merchant store code, content type, and image name. May throw a ServiceException.
